title: Cwikel estimates and Weyl's laws for $L\log L$ potentials on quantum tori
summary: We prove an $L\log L$-endpoint Cwikel estimate on quantum tori $\mathbb T_θ^d$, i.e., for every $d\geq 2$ and $x\in L\log L(\mathbb T_θ^d)$, \begin{equation*} \big\|(1-Δ)^{-\frac{d}{4}}λ(x)(1-Δ)^{-\frac{d}{4}}\big\|_{\mathcal{L}_{1,\infty}} \leq C_d \Norm{x}_{L\log L(\mathbb T_θ^d)}, \end{equation*} where $λ(x)$ is the left multiplication by $x$. Our argument actually gives an abstract weak Hilbert--Schmidt estimate for multiplication operators in finite von Neumann algebras whose $L_2$-spaces admit orthonormal bases of unitaries. As a consequence, it yields a critical Sobolev embedding…
